headline: Want to know why
body: you stop growing when you do

headline: Your growth plate
body: Your growth plate is *avascular*. That means it has no blood vessels running through it. | Every other tissue in your body gets oxygen delivered. This one does not. | Oxygen is how cells make *ATP* efficiently.
punch: No blood supply means no efficient energy.

headline: So the cells
body: *Chondrocytes* are the cells in your growth plate that divide to make bone longer. | Without oxygen they make ATP through *glycolysis* instead. | Glycolysis produces 2 ATP per glucose. Oxygen based production makes 32.
punch: Your growth plate runs on 6% of the energy other tissue gets.

headline: This is why
body: Height growth is the slowest anabolic process in your body. | Muscle can grow in weeks. Bone length takes years. | It is not because the signal is weak. The cells are energy limited.
punch: You are not growing slowly because of hormones.

headline: And it explains
body: Anything that lowers oxygen delivery to cartilage lowers the ceiling on growth rate. | Anything that raises local energy availability raises it. | This is upstream of every hormone people argue about.
punch: Energy comes first. Hormones come second.

headline: The resting zone
body: At the top of the plate sits a thin layer of stem cells called the *resting zone*. | Every one of their divisions produces the columns that lengthen bone. | They have a **finite** number of divisions in them.
punch: This is the actual limit on your height.

headline: And they empty fast
body: In rabbits over **95%** of resting zone cells were dividing at birth. | By 17 weeks that dropped under **10%**. | The cell count fell too. Not just the activity.
punch: Fewer cells and less active. It drains both ways.

headline: Which means
body: Your plates are a *bank account*, not a timer. | Every division is a withdrawal. Nothing puts anything back. | When the account empties, growth stops and the plate fuses.
punch: Fusion is the receipt. Not the cause.

headline: Here is the proof
body: They transplanted growth plates between young and old animals. | Young plate in an old animal grew fast. | Old plate in a young animal stayed slow.
punch: Growth rate followed the *donor*. Every time.

headline: So the clock
body: is not in your body. It is inside the plate. | Not your hormones. Not your age. Not a signal from your brain. | The plate carries its own history and that history runs out.
punch: Your bones keep their own score.

headline: Which changes
body: Delaying fusion is the wrong target. | *Preserving proliferative capacity* is the real one. | Those sound identical and they are not.
punch: Chasing a date instead of the thing that sets the date.

headline: And this is why
body: Slowing growth temporarily **preserves** height. | Suppress growth and the plate spends its reserve slower. | Release it and growth exceeds normal for age. That is catch up growth.
punch: Growing faster and growing longer are competing goals.

headline: It's never over
body: Real mechanisms. Real citations. No protocols.
